info.name: Fetch cost traces for an organization

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of traces to return (1-1000)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of traces to skip for pagination

params.name: startTime
params.description: Filter traces starting from this time (ISO 8601 format)

params.name: endTime
params.description: Filter traces up to this time (ISO 8601 format)

params.name: externalCustomerId
params.description: Filter traces by external customer ID

params.name: externalProductId
params.description: Filter traces by external product ID

params.name: externalAgentId
params.description: DEPRECATED: Use externalProductId instead. Filter traces by external agent ID

params.name: metadata
params.description: Filter traces by metadata fields. Must be a valid JSON object (e.g., {"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}). All specified fields must match (AND logic).

items.docs: Fetch cost traces for an organization
